operations.instruction: Update the renamed parseQuantity(value) export to return {units,source}. Accept numbers only when nonnegative safe integers, returning source="number". Accept strings only when trimming yields a nonempty sequence of ASCII digits and its numeric value is a nonnegative safe integer, returning source="string". Leading zeros, including arbitrarily many leading zeros, are valid; do not impose length restrictions. Reject all other inputs with RangeError, without coercing other input types. No parseQty export remains. Update quote(priceCents,rawQty) to validate priceCents as a nonnegative safe integer number, obtain units from parseQuantity(rawQty), and return {quantity:units,subtotalCents:priceCents*units}. Reject invalid priceCents or an unsafe product with RangeError. Preserve module interfaces except for these specified return-value changes.

Keep receipt(priceCents, rawQty) and its quote import. Call the updated quote once, consume its {quantity,subtotalCents} object, and return `${quantity} units: ${subtotalCents} cents`. For example receipt(125,"2") returns "2 units: 250 cents". Propagate quote errors.
